## Data

- **Series de datos estimadas de formalidad laboral más allá del empleo asalariado en Argentina a partir de la Encuesta Permanente de Hogares (EPH), 2016-T4 – 2025-T4** *(with Bárbara Boggiano)*
  Universidad Nacional de Rosario, 2026. Quarterly formality and informality series for all employed workers under the expanded 17th ICLS concept, with the unobserved span estimated by post-LASSO backcasting. [→ Dataset](https://doi.org/10.57715/UNR/L9HKDW){target="_blank"}

- **EPH – Observatorio. Encuesta Permanente de Hogares de Argentina. Explicada, etiquetada y ampliada** *(with Santiago Moleres & Laureano E. Hess)*
  Universidad Nacional de Rosario, 2024. [→ Dataset](https://doi.org/10.57715/UNR/BL85Z8){target="_blank"} [→ separa_eph.R](scripts/separa_eph.R){download="separa_eph.R"}

*All EPH-related materials — research, documentation, datasets, and reports — are collected in the [EPH Ecosystem](eph.qmd) page.*

## Reports & Outreach

Director and co-author of over 60 research and outreach reports published between 2015 and 2026 through the [Observatorio Económico Social UNR](https://observatorio.unr.edu.ar){target="_blank"} (ISSN 2683-9067), covering labor markets, monetary policy, housing, energy, and regional economics. All reports are available through the [UNR institutional repository](http://hdl.handle.net/2133/){target="_blank"}.

Selected reports:

- **Formalidad laboral argentina. Una historia alternativa creíble**
  Observatorio Económico Social UNR, 2026. Formality and informality across the full universe of employed workers, Q4-2016 to Q3-2025, based on the estimated series. [→ Repository](https://hdl.handle.net/2133/33518){target="_blank"}

- **Nueva ley de alquileres: contexto general y situación de los estudiantes de UNR** *(with Diego Marfetán Molina, Luciano Jara Musuruana, Alfredo Bula, Lucia Papa & Patricio Almeida Gentile)*
  Observatorio Económico Social UNR, 2021. [→ Repository](http://hdl.handle.net/2133/22647){target="_blank"}

- **Pre-Covid: Indicadores socio-económicos para AGR y Argentina** *(with Luciano Jara Musuruana, Diego Marfetán Molina, Lucia Papa & Patricio Almeida Gentile)*
  Observatorio Económico Social UNR, 2020. [→ Repository](http://hdl.handle.net/2133/18367){target="_blank"}

- **La educación en Santa Fe y Rosario: resultados Aprender 2016** *(with Patricio Almeida Gentile)*
  Observatorio Económico Social UNR, 2017. [→ Repository](http://hdl.handle.net/2133/17542){target="_blank"}

- **10 preguntas para entender las variaciones del tipo de cambio**
  Observatorio Económico Social UNR, 2016. [→ Repository](http://hdl.handle.net/2133/14520){target="_blank"}
